construction.name: snub_cube_complete_cell_contact_return
construction.parameter: y is the positive real root of y^3+y^2+y=1; R is the native square-face radius, alpha^2/sqrt(2+2alpha^2) with alpha=1/y
construction.source_proof: After division by R, each canonical snub cube lies in C={|x_i|<=1, sum|x_i|<=1+y+y^2}. A lattice difference is (2a+l,2(y+y^2)l,2b-l). For |l|>=2, its middle coordinate exceeds 2. For l=0 a nonzero difference has an outer coordinate at least 2. For |l|=1 the outer coordinates are odd: if either has magnitude >=3 a coordinate separates; otherwise the L1 norm equals 2(1+y+y^2). Thus the whole C cells, and hence all snub cubes, have disjoint interiors for every nonzero integer word.
construction.pair_normal_semantics: Rational direction proposals from the full difference-body facets. Actual supports are recomputed from every exact canonical vertex; no rounded offset is assumed exact.
construction.return_operation: Retain one realized directed separator for every pair of whole source owners and all38 host walls. Solve their common boundary, then repeat with separators exposed by the complete preceding state. Every owner retains identity orientation.
construction.native_decoder: The stored numeric centers equal binary64 rounding of the listed returned centers times(1+1e-7). The stored s_full is nextafter(nominal*(1+1e-7)+1e-7,+infinity). All resulting stored numbers are treated as exact rational inputs by the native interval proof, not as uncertain floating-point approximations.
construction.native_verification: Canonical snub-cube field, all owner vertices against all38 host faces, and one strict rational separating plane for every close pair; remote pairs use a rigorous circumradius bound.
